$05:B106              .db $4C,$50                     ; Per state: size at which to start text ($4C) or erase it ($50)

$05:B108              .db $50,$00                     ; Per state: final box size ($50 open, $00 closed)

$05:B10A              .db $04,$FC                     ; Per state: size step per frame (+4 opening, -4 closing)

$05:B10C 8B           PHB                             ; Save data bank
$05:B10D 4B           PHK                             ; \
$05:B10E AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($05)
$05:B10F AE 88 1B     LDX.W $1B88                     ; X = [$1B88]: box state (0 = opening/open, 1 = closing)
$05:B112 AD 89 1B     LDA.W $1B89                     ; A = [$1B89]: box size (0-$50), half-width of the window in pixels
$05:B115 DD 08 B1     CMP.W $B108,X                   ; Compare with the final size for this state ($50 open, $00 closed)
$05:B118 D0 77        BNE $B191                       ; Not final yet: go animate
$05:B11A 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:B11B F0 15        BEQ $B132                       ; / State 0, fully open: wait for a button press ($B132)
$05:B11D 9C 26 14     STZ.W $1426                     ; Box closed: no message box active ([$1426] = 0)
$05:B120 9C 88 1B     STZ.W $1B88                     ; [$1B88] = 0 (ready for the next message)
$05:B123 64 41        STZ $41                         ; \
$05:B125 64 42        STZ $42                         ; |
$05:B127 64 43        STZ $43                         ; } Clear window masks [$41], [$42], [$43]
$05:B129 9C 9F 0D     STZ.W $0D9F                     ; HDMA channel enable = 0 (stop the window HDMA)
$05:B12C A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$05:B12E 85 44        STA $44                         ; / [$44] = 2: color math control back to normal
$05:B130 80 5C        BRA $B18E                       ; Restore data bank and return

$05:B132 AD 09 01     LDA.W $0109                     ; \
$05:B135 0D D2 13     ORA.W $13D2                     ; } A = [$0109] | [$13D2]: intro level or Switch Palace message
$05:B138 F0 34        BEQ $B16E                       ; Neither: just wait for a button press
$05:B13A AD F5 1D     LDA.W $1DF5                     ; \
$05:B13D F0 2F        BEQ $B16E                       ; / Timer [$1DF5] = 0: wait for a button press
$05:B13F A5 13        LDA RAM_FrameCounter            ; \
$05:B141 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; / Only every 4th frame...
$05:B143 D0 49        BNE $B18E                       ; ...otherwise keep waiting
$05:B145 CE F5 1D     DEC.W $1DF5                     ; \
$05:B148 D0 44        BNE $B18E                       ; / ...count the timer down; wait until it reaches 0
$05:B14A AD D2 13     LDA.W $13D2                     ; \
$05:B14D F0 1F        BEQ $B16E                       ; / Timer expired: if [$13D2] = 0 (intro level), wait for a button press
$05:B14F AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank (Switch Palace message timed out)
$05:B150 EE E9 1D     INC.W $1DE9                     ; Probably a game-state counter: [$1DE9]++
$05:B153 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$05:B155 8D CE 13     STA.W $13CE                     ; / [$13CE] = 1 (level cleared flag, probably)
$05:B158 80 0B        BRA $B165                       ; Go end the level

$05:B15A AB           PLB                             ; Restore data bank (intro level ended by a button press)
$05:B15B A9 8E        LDA.B #$8E                      ; \
$05:B15D 8D 19 1F     STA.W $1F19                     ; / [$1F19] = $8E (probably a save/progress flag set when the intro ends)

;;; $B160: Message box: close, draw text, animate (SubSideExit) ;;;
;; Second half of the in-level message box routine (entry $B10C is in the previous chunk, called from
;;     InLevelGameMode while [$1426] != 0).
;; [$1B88] = state (0 opening, 1 closing), [$1B89] = box size 0-$50 in steps of 4. Opening: at size $4C builds
;;     the text, at $50 waits for a button.
;; Text: looks up the message for level [$13BF] and message number [$1426], writes 8 rows of 18 tiles to the
;;     stripe image buffer for BG3.
;; Switch palace messages ([$13D2] != 0) also draw the switch icons in OAM. The box itself is a window HDMA
;;     table (channel 7) growing from the center.
;; Closing: at size $50 hides the icons and blanks the text via stripe image 9; at size 0 resets the window
;;     registers.
;; $05B160 (entry from the intro skip) clears [$0109], sets [$0DD5] = 0 and the game mode to $0B.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:E99C: Mario level collision, borders and water
$05:B160 9C 09 01     STZ.W $0109                     ; Clear [$0109] (intro level flag)
$05:B163 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$05:B165 8D D5 0D     STA.W $0DD5                     ; / [$0DD5] = 0 (no level exit type)
$05:B168 A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; \
$05:B16A 8D 00 01     STA.W RAM_GameMode              ; / Game mode = $0B (probably: leave the level for the overworld)
$05:B16D 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$05:B16E A5 15        LDA RAM_ControllerA             ; A = controller 1 buttons held (byetUDLR)
$05:B170 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; \
$05:B172 F0 1A        BEQ $B18E                       ; / None of B/Y/Select/Start held: do nothing
$05:B174 45 16        EOR $16                         ; \
$05:B176 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } Only newly pressed buttons held? Yes: close the box ($05B186)
$05:B178 F0 0C        BEQ $B186                       ; /
$05:B17A A5 17        LDA RAM_ControllerB             ; \
$05:B17C 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; } None of A/X held: do nothing
$05:B17E F0 0E        BEQ $B18E                       ; /
$05:B180 45 18        EOR $18                         ; \
$05:B182 29 C0        AND.B #$C0                      ; } A/X not newly pressed: do nothing
$05:B184 D0 08        BNE $B18E                       ; /
$05:B186 AD 09 01     LDA.W $0109                     ; \
$05:B189 D0 CF        BNE $B15A                       ; / Intro level ([$0109] != 0): go to $05B15A (set [$1F19] = $8E and leave)
$05:B18B EE 88 1B     INC.W $1B88                     ; [$1B88] = 1: start closing the box
$05:B18E 4C 99 B2     JMP.W $B299                     ; Restore the data bank and return ($05B299)

$05:B191 DD 06 B1     CMP.W $B106,X                   ; Box size == trigger size? ($4C while opening, $50 when closing starts)
$05:B194 D0 0A        BNE $B1A0                       ; Not at the trigger size: just animate
$05:B196 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:B197 F0 0A        BEQ $B1A3                       ; / Opening (state 0): build the text now ($05B1A3)
$05:B199 20 1B B3     JSR.W $B31B                     ; Closing: hide the switch icon sprites
$05:B19C A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$05:B19E 85 12        STA $12                         ; / [$12] = 9: stripe image that blanks the text ($B0FF)
$05:B1A0 4C 50 B2     JMP.W $B250                     ; Continue with the window animation

$05:B1A3 A2 16        LDX.B #$16                      ; X = $16: search the message table from the last entry
$05:B1A5 A0 01        LDY.B #$01                      ; Y = 1: first message of a level
$05:B1A7 BD 90 A5     LDA.W $A590,X                   ; A = level number (bit 7: second message) of this entry
$05:B1AA 10 03        BPL $B1AF                       ; \
$05:B1AC C8           INY                             ; } Bit 7 set: Y = 2 (second message), A = level number
$05:B1AD 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; /
$05:B1AF CC 26 14     CPY.W $1426                     ; \
$05:B1B2 D0 05        BNE $B1B9                       ; / Message number [$1426] != Y: try the next entry
$05:B1B4 CD BF 13     CMP.W $13BF                     ; \
$05:B1B7 F0 03        BEQ $B1BC                       ; / Level [$13BF] matches? Yes: found the message
$05:B1B9 CA           DEX                             ; \
$05:B1BA D0 E9        BNE $B1A5                       ; / Next entry (X = 0 if none matched)
$05:B1BC AC 26 14     LDY.W $1426                     ; \
$05:B1BF C0 03        CPY.B #$03                      ; } Message number 3 ...
$05:B1C1 D0 02        BNE $B1C5                       ; /
$05:B1C3 A2 18        LDX.B #$18                      ; ... always uses entry $18
$05:B1C5 E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$05:B1C7 B0 08        BCS $B1D1                       ; / Entries 0-3 are the switch palace messages; others skip ahead
$05:B1C9 E8           INX                             ; \
$05:B1CA 8E D2 13     STX.W $13D2                     ; } [$13D2] = X + 1 (switch palace message flag)
$05:B1CD CA           DEX                             ; /
$05:B1CE 20 EB B2     JSR.W $B2EB                     ; Draw the switch icons for palace X in OAM
$05:B1D1 E0 16        CPX.B #$16                      ; \
$05:B1D3 D0 06        BNE $B1DB                       ; |
$05:B1D5 AD 7A 18     LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi               ; |
$05:B1D8 F0 01        BEQ $B1DB                       ; } Message $16 while riding Yoshi: use message $17 instead
$05:B1DA E8           INX                             ; /
$05:B1DB 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:B1DC 0A           ASL                             ; } X = message index * 2
$05:B1DD AA           TAX                             ; /
$05:B1DE C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:B1E0 BD A7 A5     LDA.W $A5A7,X                   ; A = offset of this message in the text table $A5D9
$05:B1E3 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = text offset
$05:B1E5 C2 10        REP #$10                        ; X and Y 16-bit
$05:B1E7 AF 7B 83 7F  LDA.L $7F837B                   ; \
$05:B1EB AA           TAX                             ; / X = write index into the stripe image buffer ($7F:837D)
$05:B1EC A0 0E 00     LDY.W #$000E                    ; Y = $0E: eight text rows, last one first
$05:B1EF B9 80 A5     LDA.W $A580,Y                   ; A = VRAM address (high, low) of this text row
$05:B1F2 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; Stripe header: VRAM address
$05:B1F6 A9 00 23     LDA.W #$2300                    ; \
$05:B1F9 9F 7F 83 7F  STA.L $7F837F,X                 ; / Stripe header: length $24 bytes (18 tiles), no RLE
$05:B1FD 5A           PHY                             ; Save the row index
$05:B1FE E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:B200 A9 12        LDA.B #$12                      ; \
$05:B202 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = 18 tiles per row
$05:B204 64 03        STZ $03                         ; [$03] = 0: previous character did not end the line
$05:B206 A4 00        LDY $00                         ; Y = text offset
$05:B208 A9 1F        LDA.B #$1F                      ; A = $1F: blank tile
$05:B20A 2C 03 00     BIT.W $0003                     ; \
$05:B20D 30 09        BMI $B218                       ; / Previous character ended the line (bit 7)? Then keep the blank
$05:B20F B9 D9 A5     LDA.W $A5D9,Y                   ; A = next text character
$05:B212 8D 03 00     STA.W $0003                     ; Remember it (bit 7 = last character of the line)
$05:B215 29 7F        AND.B #$7F                      ; Strip the end-of-line bit
$05:B217 C8           INY                             ; Advance the text pointer
$05:B218 9F 81 83 7F  STA.L $7F8381,X                 ; Stripe data: tile number
$05:B21C A9 39        LDA.B #$39                      ; \
$05:B21E 9F 82 83 7F  STA.L $7F8382,X                 ; / Stripe data: attributes $39 (palette 6, priority, tile page 1)
$05:B222 E8           INX                             ; \
$05:B223 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$05:B224 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$05:B226 D0 E0        BNE $B208                       ; / Next tile of the row (18 in all)
$05:B228 84 00        STY $00                         ; Save the text offset for the next row
$05:B22A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:B22C E8           INX                             ; \
$05:B22D E8           INX                             ; |
$05:B22E E8           INX                             ; } X += 4: skip the header of the next record
$05:B22F E8           INX                             ; /
$05:B230 7A           PLY                             ; Restore the row index
$05:B231 88           DEY                             ; \
$05:B232 88           DEY                             ; } Y -= 2; loop for all eight rows
$05:B233 10 BA        BPL $B1EF                       ; /
$05:B235 A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; \
$05:B238 9F 7D 83 7F  STA.L $7F837D,X                 ; / Terminate the stripe image with $FF
$05:B23C 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:B23D 8F 7B 83 7F  STA.L $7F837B                   ; / Save the new write index of the stripe buffer
$05:B241 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$05:B243 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$05:B245 8D D5 13     STA.W $13D5                     ; / [$13D5] = 1 (probably: message box is using layer 3)
$05:B248 64 22        STZ $22                         ; \
$05:B24A 64 23        STZ $23                         ; |
$05:B24C 64 24        STZ $24                         ; } BG3 scroll mirrors [$22]-[$25] = 0 (the text is on BG3)
$05:B24E 64 25        STZ $25                         ; /
$05:B250 AE 88 1B     LDX.W $1B88                     ; X = box state: 0 = opening, 1 = closing
$05:B253 AD 89 1B     LDA.W $1B89                     ; A = current box size
$05:B256 18           CLC                             ; \
$05:B257 7D 0A B1     ADC.W $B10A,X                   ; } [$1B89] += 4 (opening) or -4 (closing)
$05:B25A 8D 89 1B     STA.W $1B89                     ; /
$05:B25D 18           CLC                             ; \
$05:B25E 69 80        ADC.B #$80                      ; } B = $80 + size: right edge of the window
$05:B260 EB           XBA                             ; /
$05:B261 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$05:B263 38           SEC                             ; } A = $80 - size: left edge of the window
$05:B264 ED 89 1B     SBC.W $1B89                     ; /
$05:B267 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit: A = left edge (low) and right edge (high)
$05:B269 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the lower half of the window table
$05:B26B A0 50        LDY.B #$50                      ; Y = $50: index into the upper half
$05:B26D EC 89 1B     CPX.W $1B89                     ; \
$05:B270 90 03        BCC $B275                       ; / Row inside the current box size? Yes: keep the edges
$05:B272 A9 FF 00     LDA.W #$00FF                    ; Otherwise an empty window (left $FF, right $00)
$05:B275 99 EC 04     STA.W $04EC,Y                   ; Window HDMA table, upper half (filled from the center up)
$05:B278 9D 3C 05     STA.W $053C,X                   ; Window HDMA table, lower half (filled from the center down)
$05:B27B E8           INX                             ; \
$05:B27C E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$05:B27D 88           DEY                             ; \
$05:B27E 88           DEY                             ; } Y -= 2; loop for 40 scanlines per half
$05:B27F D0 EC        BNE $B26D                       ; /
$05:B281 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:B283 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$05:B285 85 41        STA $41                         ; / W12SEL mirror [$41] = $22: window 1 on BG1 and BG2
$05:B287 AC D2 13     LDY.W $13D2                     ; \
$05:B28A F0 02        BEQ $B28E                       ; / Switch palace message ([$13D2] != 0)?
$05:B28C A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; Yes: A = $20 (OBJ window off, probably so the icons stay visible)
$05:B28E 85 43        STA $43                         ; WOBJSEL mirror [$43]
$05:B290 A9 22        LDA.B #$22                      ; \
$05:B292 85 44        STA $44                         ; / CGWSEL mirror [$44] = $22
$05:B294 A9 80        LDA.B #$80                      ; \
$05:B296 8D 9F 0D     STA.W $0D9F                     ; / Enable HDMA channel 7 (window table)
$05:B299 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$05:B29A 6B           RTL                             ; Return



;;; $B29B..B2D3: Table: switch icon OAM tiles ;;;
;; 4 switches x (left icon 4 words + right icon 4 words) of tile number, properties for $B2EB.
$05:B29B              .db $AD,$35,$AD,$75,$AD,$B5,$AD,$F5 ; Switch 0 left icon: tile $AD, OBJ palette 2, flips none/X/Y/XY
$05:B2A3              .db $A7,$35,$A7,$75,$B7,$35,$B7,$75 ; Switch 0 right icon: tiles $A7 (top), $B7 (bottom), palette 2
$05:B2AB              .db $BD,$37,$BD,$77,$BD,$B7,$BD,$F7 ; Switch 1 left icon: tile $AD, OBJ palette 3, flips none/X/Y/XY
$05:B2B3              .db $A7,$37,$A7,$77,$B7,$37,$B7,$77 ; Switch 1 right icon: tiles $A7 (top), $B7 (bottom), palette 3
$05:B2BB              .db $AD,$39,$AD,$79,$AD,$B9,$AD,$F9 ; Switch 2 left icon: tile $AD, OBJ palette 4, flips none/X/Y/XY
$05:B2C3              .db $A7,$39,$A7,$79,$B7,$39,$B7,$79 ; Switch 2 right icon: tiles $A7 (top), $B7 (bottom), palette 4
$05:B2CB              .db $BD,$3B,$BD,$7B,$BD,$BB,$BD,$FB ; Switch 3 left icon: tile $AD, OBJ palette 5, flips none/X/Y/XY
$05:B2D3              .db $A7,$3B,$A7,$7B,$B7,$3B,$B7,$7B ; Switch 3 right icon: tiles $A7 (top), $B7 (bottom), palette 5

;;; $B2DB..B2E3: Table: switch icon OAM positions ;;;
;; X,Y byte pairs for the 8 sprites of the left and right switch icons.
$05:B2DB              .db $50,$4F,$58,$4F,$50,$57,$58,$57 ; X,Y of the left icon's four sprites: (50,4F) (58,4F) (50,57) (58,57)
$05:B2E3              .db $92,$4F,$9A,$4F,$92,$57,$9A,$57 ; X,Y of the right icon's four sprites: (92,4F) (9A,4F) (92,57) (9A,57)


;;; $B2EB: Switch icon sprites and coin counter ;;;
;; $05B2EB: draws the 8 OAM entries (sprites 0-7) of the switch palace message icons. Parameters: X = switch
;;     number 0-3.
;; $05B31B: hides those 8 sprites (Y = $F0).
;; $05B329 (unused entry) / $05B330: adds A coins to [$13CC] and subtracts them from [$0DC0] (floor 0). Called
;;     via JSL from bank 00.
;; $05B34A: adds one coin to [$13CC], plays the coin sound and decrements [$0DC0] if non-zero. Called via JSL
;;     from many banks.
;; Called by:
;;     $05:B1CE: Message box: close, draw text, animate (SubSideExit)
$05:B2EB DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$05:B2EC 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:B2ED 0A           ASL                             ; |
$05:B2EE 0A           ASL                             ; |
$05:B2EF 0A           ASL                             ; |
$05:B2F0 0A           ASL                             ; } X = switch number * 16 (offset into $B29B)
$05:B2F1 AA           TAX                             ; /
$05:B2F2 64 00        STZ $00                         ; [$00] = 0: offset into the position table
$05:B2F4 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:B2F6 A0 1C        LDY.B #$1C                      ; Y = OAM offset of sprite 7 (fills sprites 7 down to 0)
$05:B2F8 BD 9B B2     LDA.W $B29B,X                   ; A = tile number and properties
$05:B2FB 99 02 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y        ; OAM tile/properties of this sprite
$05:B2FE DA           PHX                             ; Save the tile table index
$05:B2FF A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$05:B301 BD DB B2     LDA.W $B2DB,X                   ; / A = X,Y position of this sprite
$05:B304 99 00 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y       ; OAM X,Y position
$05:B307 FA           PLX                             ; Restore the tile table index
$05:B308 E8           INX                             ; \
$05:B309 E8           INX                             ; / X += 2
$05:B30A E6 00        INC $00                         ; \
$05:B30C E6 00        INC $00                         ; / [$00] += 2
$05:B30E 88           DEY                             ; \
$05:B30F 88           DEY                             ; |
$05:B310 88           DEY                             ; } Y -= 4: previous OAM slot
$05:B311 88           DEY                             ; /
$05:B312 10 E4        BPL $B2F8                       ; Loop for 8 sprites
$05:B314 9C 00 04     STZ.W $0400                     ; Clear the OAM high table byte of sprites 0-3
$05:B317 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:B319 FA           PLX                             ; Restore X
$05:B31A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:B31B A0 1C        LDY.B #$1C                      ; Y = OAM offset of sprite 7
$05:B31D A9 F0        LDA.B #$F0                      ; A = $F0: Y position below the screen
$05:B31F 99 01 02     STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y       ; Hide this sprite
$05:B322 88           DEY                             ; \
$05:B323 88           DEY                             ; |
$05:B324 88           DEY                             ; } Y -= 4
$05:B325 88           DEY                             ; /
$05:B326 10 F7        BPL $B31F                       ; Loop for sprites 7 down to 0
$05:B328 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:B329 48           PHA                             ; Unused entry: save the coin count
$05:B32A A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$05:B32C 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play the coin sound ([$1DFC] = 1)
$05:B32F 68           PLA                             ; Restore the coin count
$05:B330 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = number of coins to add
$05:B332 18           CLC                             ; \
$05:B333 6D CC 13     ADC.W $13CC                     ; } Coin counter [$13CC] += A
$05:B336 8D CC 13     STA.W $13CC                     ; /
$05:B339 AD C0 0D     LDA.W $0DC0                     ; \
$05:B33C F0 1C        BEQ $B35A                       ; / [$0DC0] = 0: nothing to subtract, return
$05:B33E 38           SEC                             ; \
$05:B33F E5 00        SBC $00                         ; } A = [$0DC0] - coins added
$05:B341 10 02        BPL $B345                       ; /
$05:B343 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Underflow: clamp to 0
$05:B345 8D C0 0D     STA.W $0DC0                     ; Store [$0DC0] (probably coins left until some reward)
$05:B348 80 10        BRA $B35A                       ; Return

$05:B34A EE CC 13     INC.W $13CC                     ; Coin counter [$13CC] += 1
$05:B34D A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$05:B34F 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Play the coin sound ([$1DFC] = 1)
$05:B352 AD C0 0D     LDA.W $0DC0                     ; \
$05:B355 F0 03        BEQ $B35A                       ; / [$0DC0] = 0: return
$05:B357 CE C0 0D     DEC.W $0DC0                     ; [$0DC0] -= 1
$05:B35A 6B           RTL                             ; Return



;;; $B35B..B35B: Table: single-bit masks ;;;
;; $80, $40, ... $01.
$05:B35B              .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01 ; Bit masks $80 down to $01 (bit 7 first)


;;; $B363: Unused. Test overworld level-cleared flag ;;;
;; Parameters: Y = bit number. Returns: A = bit of [$1F02 + Y/8] (non-zero if set).
$05:B363 98           TYA                             ; \
$05:B364 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } Save the bit number (Y AND 7)
$05:B366 48           PHA                             ; /
$05:B367 98           TYA                             ; \
$05:B368 4A           LSR                             ; |
$05:B369 4A           LSR                             ; |
$05:B36A 4A           LSR                             ; } X = Y / 8: byte index
$05:B36B AA           TAX                             ; /
$05:B36C BD 02 1F     LDA.W $1F02,X                   ; A = byte of the overworld level-cleared flags
$05:B36F FA           PLX                             ; X = bit number
$05:B370 3F 5B B3 05  AND.L $B35B,X                   ; \
$05:B374 6B           RTL                             ; / A = flag byte AND bit mask: non-zero if set, return

$05:BB39 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$05:BB3A 4B           PHK                             ; \
$05:BB3B AB           PLB                             ; / Data bank = program bank ($05)
$05:BB3C A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \
$05:BB3E 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } [$00] = frame number = [$14] AND 7
$05:BB40 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$05:BB42 0A           ASL                             ; \
$05:BB43 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } Y = frame * 3 (first of the three animation slots)
$05:BB45 A8           TAY                             ; /
$05:BB46 0A           ASL                             ; \
$05:BB47 AA           TAX                             ; / X = frame * 6 (offset into the VRAM destination tables)
$05:BB48 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:BB4A A5 14        LDA RAM_FrameCounterB           ; \

$05:BB4F 4A           LSR                             ; |

$05:BB53 BD 3B B9     LDA.W $B93B,X                   ; \
$05:BB56 8D 80 0D     STA.W $0D80                     ; / [$0D80] = VRAM destination of tile 3
$05:BB59 BD 3D B9     LDA.W $B93D,X                   ; \
$05:BB5C 8D 7E 0D     STA.W $0D7E                     ; / [$0D7E] = VRAM destination of tile 2
$05:BB5F BD 3F B9     LDA.W $B93F,X                   ; \
$05:BB62 8D 7C 0D     STA.W $0D7C                     ; / [$0D7C] = VRAM destination of tile 1
$05:BB65 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; X = 4: index of the animated tile slot (4, 2, 0)
$05:BB67 5A           PHY                             ; Save the slot index Y
$05:BB68 DA           PHX                             ; Save X
$05:BB69 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:BB6B 98           TYA                             ; A = animation row for this slot
$05:BB6C BE 6B B9     LDX.W $B96B,Y                   ; X = slot type
$05:BB6F F0 17        BEQ $BB88                       ; Type 0: fixed row, use A as is
$05:BB71 CA           DEX                             ; \
$05:BB72 D0 0D        BNE $BB81                       ; / Type 2: go to the tileset-dependent case ($05BB81)
$05:BB74 BE 7D B9     LDX.W $B97D,Y                   ; Type 1: X = timer selector for this slot
$05:BB77 BC AD 14     LDY.W RAM_BluePowTimer,X        ; \
$05:BB7A F0 0C        BEQ $BB88                       ; / Y = switch timer [$14AD + X]; zero: keep the normal row
$05:BB7C 18           CLC                             ; \
$05:BB7D 69 26        ADC.B #$26                      ; / Timer running: use the row $26 further on (changed graphics)
$05:BB7F 80 07        BRA $BB88                       ; Done with this slot

$05:BB81 AC 31 19     LDY.W $1931                     ; Y = level tileset [$1931]
$05:BB84 18           CLC                             ; \

$05:BB88 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; A and index 16-bit
$05:BB8A 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; Keep the row number
$05:BB8D 0A           ASL                             ; \
$05:BB8E 0A           ASL                             ; } A = row * 8 (4 frames of 2 bytes each)
$05:BB8F 0A           ASL                             ; /
$05:BB90 05 00        ORA $00                         ; Add the frame offset: A = byte offset in AnimatedTileData
$05:BB92 A8           TAY                             ; Y = byte offset
$05:BB93 B9 99 B9     LDA.W AnimatedTileData,Y        ; A = source address of this frame's tile graphics (bank $7E)
$05:BB96 E2 10        SEP #$10                        ; X and Y 8-bit

$05:BB99 9D 76 0D     STA.W $0D76,X                   ; Source address for the NMI tile DMA ([$0D76] + X)
$05:BB9C 7A           PLY                             ; Restore Y
$05:BB9D C8           INY                             ; Next entry of the slot tables
$05:BB9E CA           DEX                             ; \
$05:BB9F CA           DEX                             ; } X -= 2; loop for the three slots
$05:BBA0 10 C5        BPL $BB67                       ; /
$05:BBA2 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:BBA4 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$05:BBA5 6B           RTL                             ; Return

;;; $BC00: Run scroll routines, compute scroll deltas ;;;
;; $05BC00: runs the layer 1 scroll routine ([$143E]) and the layer 2 scroll routine ([$143F]), then stores
;;     the per-frame scroll deltas of layer 1 in [$17BC]/[$17BD] and of layer 2 in [$17BE]/[$17BF]. Skips layer 3
;;     handling while the message box is up.
;; $05BC4A: [$26]/[$28] = position of layer 2 (or layer 3 if [$1403] != 0) relative to layer 1. $05BC72: long-
;;     call wrapper.
;; $05BC76: layer 1 dispatch ([$1456] = 0): returns if sprites are locked or [$143E] = 0.
;; Called by:
;;     $00:9A5C: Boss room frame code (bit 6 set)
;;     $00:A29D: Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode)
$05:BC00 8B           PHB                             ; \
$05:BC01 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($05)
$05:BC02 AB           PLB                             ; /
$05:BC03 20 76 BC     JSR.W $BC76                     ; Run the layer 1 scroll routine for [$143E] with [$1456] = 0
$05:BC06 20 A5 BC     JSR.W $BCA5                     ; Run the layer 2 scroll routine for [$143F] with [$1456] = 4
$05:BC09 20 4A BC     JSR.W $BC4A                     ; Compute the layer 2 offset from layer 1 into [$26]/[$28]
$05:BC0C AD 62 14     LDA.W $1462                     ; \
$05:BC0F 38           SEC                             ; |
$05:BC10 E5 1A        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo          ; |
$05:BC12 18           CLC                             ; |
$05:BC13 6D BD 17     ADC.W $17BD                     ; } [$17BD] += [$1462] - [$1A]: layer 1 X scroll this frame
$05:BC16 8D BD 17     STA.W $17BD                     ; /
$05:BC19 AD 64 14     LDA.W $1464                     ; \
$05:BC1C 38           SEC                             ; |
$05:BC1D E5 1C        SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo          ; |
$05:BC1F 18           CLC                             ; |
$05:BC20 6D BC 17     ADC.W $17BC                     ; } [$17BC] += [$1464] - [$1C]: layer 1 Y scroll this frame
$05:BC23 8D BC 17     STA.W $17BC                     ; /
$05:BC26 AD 66 14     LDA.W $1466                     ; \
$05:BC29 38           SEC                             ; } A = [$1466] - [$1E]: layer 2 X scroll
$05:BC2A E5 1E        SBC $1E                         ; /
$05:BC2C AC 3F 14     LDY.W $143F                     ; \
$05:BC2F 88           DEY                             ; |
$05:BC30 D0 01        BNE $BC33                       ; } If [$143F] = 1, force the layer 2 X scroll to 0
$05:BC32 98           TYA                             ; /
$05:BC33 8D BF 17     STA.W $17BF                     ; [$17BF] = layer 2 X scroll this frame
$05:BC36 AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$05:BC39 38           SEC                             ; } A = [$1468] - [$20]: layer 2 Y scroll
$05:BC3A E5 20        SBC $20                         ; /
$05:BC3C 8D BE 17     STA.W $17BE                     ; [$17BE] = layer 2 Y scroll this frame
$05:BC3F AD D5 13     LDA.W $13D5                     ; \
$05:BC42 D0 03        BNE $BC47                       ; / [$13D5] set (message box up): skip layer 3 handling
$05:BC44 20 0C C4     JSR.W $C40C                     ; Run $C40C (probably layer 3 scroll handling)
$05:BC47 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$05:BC48 6B           RTL                             ; Return

$05:BC49 60           RTS                             ; Return (shared no-op target of the scroll tables)

$05:BC4A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:BC4C AC 03 14     LDY.W $1403                     ; \
$05:BC4F D0 0E        BNE $BC5F                       ; / [$1403] = 0: use layer 2, else layer 3 ($05BC5F)
$05:BC51 AD 66 14     LDA.W $1466                     ; \
$05:BC54 38           SEC                             ; |
$05:BC55 ED 62 14     SBC.W $1462                     ; } [$26] = [$1466] - [$1462]: layer 2 X relative to layer 1
$05:BC58 85 26        STA $26                         ; /
$05:BC5A AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; A = layer 2 Y ([$1468])
$05:BC5D 80 0A        BRA $BC69                       ; Go compute the Y offset

$05:BC5F A5 22        LDA $22                         ; \
$05:BC61 38           SEC                             ; |
$05:BC62 ED 62 14     SBC.W $1462                     ; } [$26] = [$22] - [$1462]: layer 3 X relative to layer 1
$05:BC65 85 26        STA $26                         ; /
$05:BC67 A5 24        LDA $24                         ; A = layer 3 Y ([$24])
$05:BC69 38           SEC                             ; \
$05:BC6A ED 64 14     SBC.W $1464                     ; } [$28] = A - [$1464]: Y relative to layer 1
$05:BC6D 85 28        STA $28                         ; /
$05:BC6F E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:BC71 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:BC72 20 4A BC     JSR.W $BC4A                     ; Compute the layer 2 offset into [$26]/[$28]
$05:BC75 6B           RTL                             ; Return (long)

$05:BC76 9C 56 14     STZ.W $1456                     ; [$1456] = 0: layer 1 phase
$05:BC79 AD 9D 00     LDA.W RAM_SpritesLocked         ; \
$05:BC7C D0 CB        BNE $BC49                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$05:BC7E AD 3E 14     LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; \
$05:BC81 F0 C6        BEQ $BC49                       ; / No scroll routine ([$143E] = 0): return
$05:BC83 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the routine for [$143E] (Ptrs05BC87)

$05:BC8B 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 02 - 02 - Layer 2 Smash ($BC49)
$05:BC8D 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 03 - 03 - Layer 2 Scroll ($BC49)
$05:BC8F 83 C2        .dw $C283                       ; 04 - 04 - Unused ($C283)
$05:BC91 9E C6        .dw $C69E                       ; 05 - 05 - Unused ($C69E)
$05:BC93 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 06 - 06 - Layer 2 Falls ($BC49)
$05:BC95 F5 BF        .dw $BFF5                       ; 07 - 07 - Unused ($BFF5)
$05:BC97 1F C5        .dw $C51F                       ; 08 - 08 - Layer 2 Scroll ($C51F)
$05:BC99 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 09 - 09 - Unused ($BC49)
$05:BC9B 2E C3        .dw $C32E                       ; 0A - 0A - Unused ($C32E)
$05:BC9D 27 C7        .dw $C727                       ; 0B - 0B - Layer 2 On/Off Switch controlled ($C727)
$05:BC9F 87 C7        .dw $C787                       ; 0C - 0C - Auto-Scroll level ($C787)
$05:BCA1 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 0D - 0D - Fast BG scroll ($BC49)
$05:BCA3 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 0E - 0E - Layer 2 sink/rise ($BC49)

$05:BCA5 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$05:BCA7 8D 56 14     STA.W $1456                     ; / [$1456] = 4: layer 2 phase
$05:BCAA AD 3F 14     LDA.W $143F                     ; \
$05:BCAD F0 9A        BEQ $BC49                       ; / No layer 2 scroll type ([$143F] = 0): return
$05:BCAF AC 9D 00     LDY.W RAM_SpritesLocked         ; \
$05:BCB2 D0 95        BNE $BC49                       ; / Sprites locked: return
$05:BCB4 22 DF 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtr                ; Jump to the routine for [$143F] (Ptrs05BCB8)

$05:BCB8 4D C0        .dw $C04D                       ; 00 - $C04D
$05:BCBA 98 C1        .dw $C198                       ; 01 - $C198
$05:BCBC 55 C9        .dw $C955                       ; 02 - $C955
$05:BCBE BB C5        .dw $C5BB                       ; 03 - $C5BB
$05:BCC0 83 C2        .dw $C283                       ; 04 - $C283
$05:BCC2 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 05 - $BC49
$05:BCC4 59 C6        .dw $C659                       ; 06 - $C659
$05:BCC6 F5 BF        .dw $BFF5                       ; 07 - $BFF5
$05:BCC8 1F C5        .dw $C51F                       ; 08 - $C51F
$05:BCCA C1 C7        .dw $C7C1                       ; 09 - $C7C1
$05:BCCC 2E C3        .dw $C32E                       ; 0A - $C32E
$05:BCCE 27 C7        .dw $C727                       ; 0B - $C727
$05:BCD0 87 C7        .dw $C787                       ; 0C - $C787
$05:BCD2 BC C7        .dw $C7BC                       ; 0D - $C7BC
$05:BCD4 1C C8        .dw $C81C                       ; 0E - $C81C

$05:BCD6 8B           PHB                             ; \
$05:BCD7 4B           PHK                             ; } Data bank = program bank ($05)
$05:BCD8 AB           PLB                             ; /
$05:BCD9 9C 56 14     STZ.W $1456                     ; [$1456] = 0
$05:BCDC 20 E9 BC     JSR.W $BCE9                     ; Run the second-pass routine for [$143E]
$05:BCDF A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \

$05:BCE4 20 0E BD     JSR.W $BD0E                     ; Run the second-pass routine for [$143F]

$05:BCF8 DD BD        .dw $BDDD                       ; 04 - 04 - Unused ($BDDD)
$05:BCFA BA BF        .dw $BFBA                       ; 05 - 05 - Unused ($BFBA)
$05:BCFC 97 BF        .dw $BF97                       ; 06 - 06 - Layer 2 Falls ($BF97)
$05:BCFE 35 BD        .dw $BD35                       ; 07 - 07 - Unused ($BD35)
$05:BD00 A6 BE        .dw $BEA6                       ; 08 - 08 - Layer 2 Scroll ($BEA6)
$05:BD02 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 09 - 09 - Unused ($BC49)
$05:BD04 3A BE        .dw $BE3A                       ; 0A - 0A - Unused ($BE3A)

;;; $BD17: Layer 2 scroll sprites: init and shared setup (Ptrs05BD17) ;;;
;; Init routines for the level's scroll sprites (auto-scroll, layer 2 scroll/smash/falls etc.), run when a
;;     scroll sprite is started.
;; $05BD0E: if [$143F] (layer 2 scroll sprite number) is non-zero, dispatches through the pointer table at
;;     $05BD17 (indexed by [$143F]).
;; $05BD36 etc.: pick the layer's command from [$1440]/[$1441] (layer 1/2) and its parameters from tables,
;;     then clear the scroll words.
;; [$1456] selects the layer (0 = layer 1, 4 = layer 2). Several entries are unused leftovers. Meaning of
;;     $1442-$1454 is hedged.
;; $05BFD2: common reset (A = scroll sprite number); $05BFF6: Layer 2 On/Off Switch init.
$05:BD17 4C BD        .dw $BD4C                       ; 00 - Auto-Scroll, unused? ($BD4C)
$05:BD19 4C BD        .dw $BD4C                       ; 01 - Auto-Scroll ($BD4C)
$05:BD1B 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 02 - Layer 2 Smash (nothing)
$05:BD1D 20 BF        .dw $BF20                       ; 03 - Layer 2 Scroll ($BF20)
$05:BD1F F0 BD        .dw $BDF0                       ; 04 - Unused ($BDF0)
$05:BD21 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 05 - Unused (nothing)
$05:BD23 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 06 - Layer 2 Falls (nothing)
$05:BD25 35 BD        .dw $BD35                       ; 07 - Unused (nothing)
$05:BD27 C6 BE        .dw $BEC6                       ; 08 - Layer 2 Scroll ($BEC6)
$05:BD29 22 C0        .dw $C022                       ; 09 - Unused ($C022)
$05:BD2B 4D BE        .dw $BE4D                       ; 0A - Unused ($BE4D)
$05:BD2D 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 0B - Layer 2 On/Off Switch (nothing)
$05:BD2F 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 0C - Auto-Scroll level (nothing)
$05:BD31 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 0D - Fast BG scroll (nothing)
$05:BD33 49 BC        .dw $BC49                       ; 0E - Layer 2 sink/rise (nothing)

$05:BD35 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:BD36 9C 11 14     STZ.W $1411                     ; [$1411] = 0: horizontal scroll disabled for layer 1
$05:BD39 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; A = [$1440] (current auto-scroll command)
$05:BD3C 0A           ASL                             ; \
$05:BD3D A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1440] * 2 (word index)
$05:BD3E C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:BD40 B9 D1 C9     LDA.W $C9D1,Y                   ; A = next scroll sprite number from table (low byte) / [$1441] high byte
$05:BD43 8D 3E 14     STA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; [RAM_ScrollSprNum] = A (hedged: advance to next scroll command)
$05:BD46 B9 DB C9     LDA.W $C9DB,Y                   ; A = new [$1440] / [$1441] from table
$05:BD49 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440                     ; Store new command number into [$1440]/[$1441]
$05:BD4C AE 56 14     LDX.W $1456                     ; X = [$1456]: layer offset (0 = layer 1, 4 = layer 2)
$05:BD4F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:BD51 9E 46 14     STZ.W $1446,X                   ; \
$05:BD54 9E 48 14     STZ.W $1448,X                   ; |
$05:BD57 9E 4E 14     STZ.W $144E,X                   ; } Clear this layer's scroll speed/subpixel words ($1446, $1448, $144E, $1450 + X)
$05:BD5A 9E 50 14     STZ.W $1450,X                   ; /
$05:BD5D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:BD5F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:BD60 4A           LSR                             ; |
$05:BD61 4A           LSR                             ; } X = [$1456] / 4 (0 or 1: byte index for $1442/$1444)
$05:BD62 AA           TAX                             ; /
$05:BD63 AC 40 14     LDY.W $1440                     ; Y = [$1440] (command for layer 1)
$05:BD66 AD 56 14     LDA.W $1456                     ; A = [$1456]: which layer?
$05:BD69 F0 03        BEQ $BD6E                       ; Layer 1: keep Y
$05:BD6B AC 41 14     LDY.W $1441                     ; Layer 2: Y = [$1441] (command for layer 2)
$05:BD6E B9 61 CA     LDA.W $CA61,Y                   ; A = first scroll parameter for this command
$05:BD71 9D 42 14     STA.W $1442,X                   ; [$1442+layer] = A
$05:BD74 B9 68 CA     LDA.W $CA68,Y                   ; A = second scroll parameter for this command
$05:BD77 9D 44 14     STA.W $1444,X                   ; [$1444+layer] = A
$05:BD7A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:BD7B AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; Unused. A = [$1440]
$05:BD7E 0A           ASL                             ; \
$05:BD7F A8           TAY                             ; / Y = [$1440] * 2
$05:BD80 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:BD82 B9 E5 C9     LDA.W $C9E5,Y                   ; A = word from $C9E5
$05:BD85 8D 3E 14     STA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum          ; [RAM_ScrollSprNum] = A
$05:BD88 B9 E7 C9     LDA.W $C9E7,Y                   ; A = word from $C9E7

;;; $C005: Scroll sprites: path scroll and inits ;;;
;; Part of the layer 1/2 scroll sprite system. [$143E]/[$143F] hold the scroll sprite number for layer 1/layer
;;     2; [$1456] = 0 or 4 selects the layer.
;; Init routines for scroll sprites 0C (Auto-Scroll level), 0D (Fast BG scroll) and 0E (Layer 2 sink/rise),
;;     starting at $05C005, $05C01A and $05C036.
;; $05C04D: auto-scroll along a path of nodes ($CA6E/05CABE), steps and accelerates layer speed toward
;;     the next node.
;; $05C198: layer 2 variant. $05C283 (scroll sprite 04), $05C32E (0A) and $05C1AE are unused leftover movers.
;; Per layer L: [$1462+L]/[$1464+L] = X/Y position, [$1446+L]/[$1448+L] = X/Y speed, [$1442+n] = path node,
;;     [$1444+n] = segments left.
$05:C005 9C 11 14     STZ.W $1411                     ; Layer 1 horizontal scroll setting [$1411] = 0 (probably: no normal scrolling)
$05:C008 AD 40 14     LDA.W $1440                     ; \
$05:C00B 0A           ASL                             ; } Y = [$1440] * 2: word index into the BFFD table (0 or 2)
$05:C00C A8           TAY                             ; /
$05:C00D C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C00F B9 FD BF     LDA.W $BFFD,Y                   ; A = $BFFD[Y]
$05:C012 8D 40 14     STA.W $1440                     ; [$1440]/[$1441] = word from table (path set for layer 1, layer 2 = 0)
$05:C015 A9 0C 00     LDA.W #$000C                    ; A = $000C: [$143E] = 0C (Auto-Scroll level), [$143F] = 0
$05:C018 80 B8        BRA $BFD2                       ; Reset scroll sprite state and store A in [$143E] ($BFD2)

$05:C01A C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C01C A9 00 0D     LDA.W #$0D00                    ; A = $0D00: [$143F] = 0D (Fast BG scroll) for layer 2
$05:C01F 20 D2 BF     JSR.W $BFD2                     ; Reset scroll sprite state, set the scroll sprite numbers
$05:C022 9C 13 14     STZ.W $1413                     ; Layer 1 vertical scroll setting [$1413] = 0 (probably: no normal scrolling)
$05:C025 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C027 9C 4A 14     STZ.W $144A                     ; \
$05:C02A 9C 4C 14     STZ.W $144C                     ; |
$05:C02D 9C 52 14     STZ.W $1452                     ; } Clear the remaining per-layer scroll sprite words $144A, $144C, $1452, $1454
$05:C030 9C 54 14     STZ.W $1454                     ; /
$05:C033 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:C035 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:C036 AC 40 14     LDY.W $1440                     ; Y = [$1440] (path set number)
$05:C039 B9 08 C8     LDA.W $C808,Y                   ; A = $C808[Y]: number of path segments for layer 1

;;     Y = $30 and $A0.

;;     turnaround point.

$05:C624 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |

$05:C63B 1A           INC A                           ; /

$05:C63F A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: acceleration step +1
$05:C641 DD 48 14     CMP.W $1448,X                   ; \
$05:C644 F0 0E        BEQ $C654                       ; |

$05:C676 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C678 AD 4C 14     LDA.W $144C                     ; \
$05:C67B C9 C0 FF     CMP.W #$FFC0                    ; |
$05:C67E F0 04        BEQ $C684                       ; |

$05:C681 8D 4C 14     STA.W $144C                     ; /
$05:C684 AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$05:C687 C9 31 00     CMP.W #$0031                    ; |

$05:C6FE 1A           INC A                           ; } B = [$1463] - [$5E] + 2 (screens relative to the level end)

;;; $C71B..C723: Table: layer 2 switch targets ;;;
;; Indexed by X = 0 (switch ON) or 2 (OFF): target Y, speed limit, acceleration.
$05:C71B              .db $20,$00,$C1,$00             ; Layer 2 Y target: $0020 (switch ON), $00C1 (OFF)

$05:C71F              .db $C0,$FF,$40,$00             ; Layer 2 Y speed limit: $FFC0 (ON), $0040 (OFF)

$05:C723              .db $FF,$FF,$01,$00             ; Acceleration: -1 (ON), +1 (OFF)


;;; $C727: Scroll sprite 0B: layer 2 ON/OFF switch ;;;
;; Layer 2 moves vertically toward Y $0020 (ON) or $00C1 (OFF) depending on [RAM_OnOffStatus]. When the switch
;;     flips it rattles
;; for [$1445] frames first. On arrival it plays the thud sound effect and shakes the ground (ON target only),
;;     then resets the status to ON.
$05:C727 AE AF 14     LDX.W RAM_OnOffStatus           ; \
$05:C72A F0 02        BEQ $C72E                       ; } X = ON/OFF status [RAM_OnOffStatus]: 0 = ON, 2 = OFF
$05:C72C A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; /
$05:C72E EC 43 14     CPX.W $1443                     ; \
$05:C731 F0 17        BEQ $C74A                       ; / Layer state [$1443] = switch state? Yes: go to $05C74A (move)
$05:C733 CE 45 14     DEC.W $1445                     ; Switch flipped: wait timer [$1445]--
$05:C736 10 03        BPL $C73B                       ; \
$05:C738 8E 43 14     STX.W $1443                     ; / Timer expired: [$1443] = new state
$05:C73B AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$05:C73E 49 01        EOR.B #$01                      ; } Rattle: flip bit 0 of layer 2 Y [$1468] every frame
$05:C740 8D 68 14     STA.W $1468                     ; /
$05:C743 9C 4C 14     STZ.W $144C                     ; \
$05:C746 9C 4D 14     STZ.W $144D                     ; / Layer 2 Y speed [$144C] = 0
$05:C749 60           RTS                             ; Return

$05:C74A A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$05:C74C 8D 45 14     STA.W $1445                     ; / Wait timer [$1445] = $10
$05:C74F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C751 AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$05:C754 DD 1B C7     CMP.W $C71B,X                   ; } Layer 2 Y [$1468] at this state's target? No: go to $05C770
$05:C757 D0 17        BNE $C770                       ; /
$05:C759 E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; \
$05:C75B D0 0C        BNE $C769                       ; / Only for the ON target: play the landing effect, else go to $05C769
$05:C75D A9 09 00     LDA.W #$0009                    ; \
$05:C760 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Sound effect $09 (thud)
$05:C763 A9 20 00     LDA.W #$0020                    ; \
$05:C766 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Ground shake timer = $20
$05:C769 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; \
$05:C76B 8E AF 14     STX.W RAM_OnOffStatus           ; / Clear the ON/OFF status (set ON)
$05:C76E 80 14        BRA $C784                       ; Go to $05C784

$05:C770 AD 4C 14     LDA.W $144C                     ; \
$05:C773 DD 1F C7     CMP.W $C71F,X                   ; } Layer 2 Y speed [$144C] at the limit ($C71F)? Skip
$05:C776 F0 07        BEQ $C77F                       ; /
$05:C778 18           CLC                             ; \
$05:C779 7D 23 C7     ADC.W $C723,X                   ; } [$144C] += $C723 (-1 / +1)
$05:C77C 8D 4C 14     STA.W $144C                     ; /
$05:C77F A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; \
$05:C781 20 F9 C4     JSR.W $C4F9                     ; / Apply layer 2 Y speed to layer 2 Y position
$05:C784 4C 2B C3     JMP.W $C32B                     ; A 8-bit and return ($C32B)

$05:C787 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$05:C789 85 55        STA $55                         ; } [$55] = [$56] = 2 (probably scroll-direction flags)
$05:C78B 85 56        STA $56                         ; /
$05:C78D AD 56 14     LDA.W $1456                     ; \
$05:C790 4A           LSR                             ; |
$05:C791 4A           LSR                             ; } X = [$1456] / 4
$05:C792 AA           TAX                             ; /
$05:C793 BC 40 14     LDY.W $1440,X                   ; Y = [$1440+X] (stage index)
$05:C796 AE 56 14     LDX.W $1456                     ; X = [$1456]
$05:C799 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C79B BD 46 14     LDA.W $1446,X                   ; \
$05:C79E D9 01 C0     CMP.W $C001,Y                   ; |
$05:C7A1 F0 01        BEQ $C7A4                       ; |
$05:C7A3 1A           INC A                           ; } Speed [$1446+X] += 1, up to the limit [$05C001+Y]
$05:C7A4 9D 46 14     STA.W $1446,X                   ; /
$05:C7A7 A5 5E        LDA $5E                         ; \
$05:C7A9 3A           DEC A                           ; |
$05:C7AA EB           XBA                             ; |
$05:C7AB 29 00 FF     AND.W #$FF00                    ; |
$05:C7AE DD 62 14     CMP.W $1462,X                   ; |
$05:C7B1 D0 03        BNE $C7B6                       ; } At the last screen ([$5E] - 1) * $100? Then speed [$1446+X] = 0
$05:C7B3 9E 46 14     STZ.W $1446,X                   ; /

$05:C7B9 4C 2B C3     JMP.W $C32B                     ; A 8-bit and return ($C32B)

$05:C7BC AD 9A 1B     LDA.W $1B9A                     ; \
$05:C7BF F0 2C        BEQ $C7ED                       ; / [$1B9A] = 0: do nothing (go to $05C7ED)
$05:C7C1 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$05:C7C3 85 56        STA $56                         ; / [$56] = 2
$05:C7C5 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C7C7 AD 4A 14     LDA.W $144A                     ; \
$05:C7CA C9 00 04     CMP.W #$0400                    ; |
$05:C7CD F0 01        BEQ $C7D0                       ; |
$05:C7CF 1A           INC A                           ; } Layer 2 X speed [$144A] += 1, up to $0400
$05:C7D0 8D 4A 14     STA.W $144A                     ; /
$05:C7D3 A2 04        LDX.B #$04                      ; \
$05:C7D5 20 F9 C4     JSR.W $C4F9                     ; / Apply speed to layer 2 X position
$05:C7D8 AD BD 17     LDA.W $17BD                     ; \
$05:C7DB 29 FF 00     AND.W #$00FF                    ; |
$05:C7DE C9 80 00     CMP.W #$0080                    ; |
$05:C7E1 90 03        BCC $C7E6                       ; |
$05:C7E3 09 00 FF     ORA.W #$FF00                    ; |
$05:C7E6 18           CLC                             ; |
$05:C7E7 6D 66 14     ADC.W $1466                     ; } Layer 2 X [$1466] += [$17BD] (layer 1 X movement, sign-extended)
$05:C7EA 8D 66 14     STA.W $1466                     ; /
$05:C7ED 4C 2B C3     JMP.W $C32B                     ; A 8-bit and return ($C32B)



;;; $C7F0..C7F8: Table: layer 2 sink/rise X range starts ;;;
$05:C7F0              .db $00,$00,$F0,$02,$B0,$08,$00,$00 ; X range starts: $0000, $02F0, $08B0
$05:C7F8              .db $00,$00,$70,$03             ; X range starts: $0000, $0000, $0370

$05:C804              .db $40,$00,$80,$03             ; X range ends: $0008, $0040, $0380


;;; $C808..C818: Table: layer 2 sink/rise setup ;;;
;; Group offsets, entry counts, start/end heights, speed limits and accelerations for the two directions
;;     (rise, sink).
$05:C808              .db $00,$06,$08                 ; [$1444]: start offsets of the three entry groups

$05:C80B              .db $03,$01,$02                 ; [$1445]: number of entries in each group

$05:C80E              .db $C0,$00                     ; Layer 2 start Y: $00C0 (rise); next word = $0000 (sink)

$05:C810              .db $00,$00,$B0,$00             ; End Y: $0000 (rise), $00B0 (sink)

$05:C814              .db $80,$FF,$C0,$00             ; Speed limit: $FF80 (rise), $00C0 (sink)

$05:C818              .db $FF,$FF,$01,$00             ; Acceleration: -1 (rise), +1 (sink)


;;; $C81C: Scroll sprite 0E: layer 2 sink or rise ;;;
;; When layer 2 X lies in one of the listed ranges, layer 2 Y is reset to its start height. Once triggered
;;     ([$1442] / [$140E] set,
;; meaning of [$140E] unclear) it accelerates toward the end height ($0000 for rise, $00B0 for sink).
$05:C81C C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C81E 64 00        STZ $00                         ; \
$05:C820 AC 45 14     LDY.W $1445                     ; } [$00] = [$1445] (number of range entries)
$05:C823 84 00        STY $00                         ; /
$05:C825 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0: rise set
$05:C827 AE 44 14     LDX.W $1444                     ; X = [$1444] (offset of the first entry)
$05:C82A E0 08        CPX.B #$08                      ; \
$05:C82C 90 02        BCC $C830                       ; } X >= 8: Y = 2 (sink set)
$05:C82E A0 02        LDY.B #$02                      ; /
$05:C830 AD 66 14     LDA.W $1466                     ; \
$05:C833 DD F0 C7     CMP.W $C7F0,X                   ; |
$05:C836 90 14        BCC $C84C                       ; |
$05:C838 DD FC C7     CMP.W $C7FC,X                   ; } Layer 2 X [$1466] inside this entry's range [start, end)? Else go to $05C84C
$05:C83B B0 0F        BCS $C84C                       ; /
$05:C83D 9C 42 14     STZ.W $1442                     ; [$1442] = 0
$05:C840 B9 0E C8     LDA.W $C80E,Y                   ; \
$05:C843 8D 68 14     STA.W $1468                     ; / Layer 2 Y [$1468] = start height ($C80E)
$05:C846 9C 4C 14     STZ.W $144C                     ; Layer 2 Y speed = 0
$05:C849 9C 54 14     STZ.W $1454                     ; Layer 2 Y sub-pixel = 0
$05:C84C E8           INX                             ; \
$05:C84D E8           INX                             ; / Next entry
$05:C84E C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$05:C850 D0 DE        BNE $C830                       ; / Loop for all entries
$05:C852 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:C854 AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; \
$05:C857 0D 0E 14     ORA.W $140E                     ; |
$05:C85A 8D 42 14     STA.W $1442                     ; } [$1442] |= [$140E]; zero: nothing triggered, return (go to $05C87D)
$05:C85D F0 1E        BEQ $C87D                       ; /
$05:C85F C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C861 AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$05:C864 D9 10 C8     CMP.W $C810,Y                   ; } Layer 2 Y [$1468] at its end height ($C810)? Then stop
$05:C867 F0 14        BEQ $C87D                       ; /
$05:C869 AD 4C 14     LDA.W $144C                     ; \
$05:C86C D9 14 C8     CMP.W $C814,Y                   ; } Speed [$144C] at the limit ($C814)? Skip the acceleration
$05:C86F F0 04        BEQ $C875                       ; /
$05:C871 18           CLC                             ; \
$05:C872 79 18 C8     ADC.W $C818,Y                   ; / [$144C] += $C818 (-1 / +1)
$05:C875 8D 4C 14     STA.W $144C                     ; Store layer 2 Y speed [$144C]
$05:C878 A2 06        LDX.B #$06                      ; \
$05:C87A 20 F9 C4     JSR.W $C4F9                     ; / Apply layer 2 Y speed to layer 2 Y position
$05:C87D E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:C87F 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $C955: Scroll sprite 02: layer 2 smash ;;;
;; Layer 2 X in one of the ranges starts a smash cycle: layer 2 Y is set to $00C1 and it moves through a list
;;     of Y targets at the
;; given speeds, pausing between steps. Finishing a cycle of 3 phases ($12 bytes each) plays a thud and shakes
;;     the ground.
$05:C955 AE 40 14     LDX.W $1440                     ; X = [$1440] (offset of the first range entry)
$05:C958 AC 41 14     LDY.W $1441                     ; Y = [$1441] (number of entries)
$05:C95B C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C95D AD 66 14     LDA.W $1466                     ; \
$05:C960 DD 80 C8     CMP.W $C880,X                   ; |
$05:C963 90 16        BCC $C97B                       ; |
$05:C965 DD A4 C8     CMP.W $C8A4,X                   ; } Layer 2 X [$1466] inside range [DATA_05C880+X, DATA_05C8A4+X)? Else go to $05C97B
$05:C968 B0 11        BCS $C97B                       ; /
$05:C96A 8A           TXA                             ; \
$05:C96B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$05:C96C 29 FE 00     AND.W #$00FE                    ; } [$1442] = X / 2 & $FE (which range triggered)
$05:C96F 8D 42 14     STA.W $1442                     ; /
$05:C972 A9 C1 00     LDA.W #$00C1                    ; \
$05:C975 8D 68 14     STA.W $1468                     ; / Layer 2 Y [$1468] = $00C1 (start position)
$05:C978 9C 44 14     STZ.W $1444                     ; Pause timer [$1444] = 0
$05:C97B E8           INX                             ; \
$05:C97C E8           INX                             ; / Next entry
$05:C97D 88           DEY                             ; \
$05:C97E D0 DD        BNE $C95D                       ; / Loop for all entries
$05:C980 E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:C982 AD 44 14     LDA.W $1444                     ; \
$05:C985 F0 04        BEQ $C98B                       ; |
$05:C987 CE 44 14     DEC.W $1444                     ; } Pause timer [$1444] running: count it down and return
$05:C98A 60           RTS                             ; /

$05:C98B AD 42 14     LDA.W $1442                     ; \
$05:C98E 18           CLC                             ; |
$05:C98F 6D 43 14     ADC.W $1443                     ; } Y = [$1442] + [$1443]: step index into the smash tables
$05:C992 A8           TAY                             ; /
$05:C993 4A           LSR                             ; \
$05:C994 AA           TAX                             ; / X = Y / 2
$05:C995 C2 20        REP #$20                        ; A 16-bit
$05:C997 AD 68 14     LDA.W $1468                     ; \
$05:C99A 38           SEC                             ; |
$05:C99B F9 C8 C8     SBC.W $C8C8,Y                   ; |
$05:C99E 59 FE C8     EOR.W $C8FE,Y                   ; } Has Layer 2 Y passed target [DATA_05C8C8+Y] in the direction of [DATA_05C8FE+Y]? Yes: go to $05C9A9
$05:C9A1 10 06        BPL $C9A9                       ; /
$05:C9A3 B9 FE C8     LDA.W $C8FE,Y                   ; \
$05:C9A6 4C 75 C8     JMP.W $C875                     ; / Not yet: speed [$144C] = [DATA_05C8FE+Y] (go to $05C875, which moves it)

$05:C9A9 B9 C8 C8     LDA.W $C8C8,Y                   ; \
$05:C9AC 8D 68 14     STA.W $1468                     ; / Snap layer 2 Y [$1468] to the target
$05:C9AF E2 20        SEP #$20                        ; A 8-bit
$05:C9B1 BD 34 C9     LDA.W $C934,X                   ; \
$05:C9B4 8D 44 14     STA.W $1444                     ; / Pause timer [$1444] = [$05C934+X]
$05:C9B7 AD 43 14     LDA.W $1443                     ; \
$05:C9BA 18           CLC                             ; |
$05:C9BB 69 12        ADC.B #$12                      ; |
$05:C9BD C9 36        CMP.B #$36                      ; } Next phase offset [$1443] + $12 < $36? Yes: just store it
$05:C9BF 90 0C        BCC $C9CD                       ; /
$05:C9C1 A9 09        LDA.B #$09                      ; \
$05:C9C3 8D FC 1D     STA.W $1DFC                     ; / Cycle finished: sound effect $09 (thud)
$05:C9C6 A9 20        LDA.B #$20                      ; \
$05:C9C8 8D 87 18     STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer        ; / Ground shake timer = $20
$05:C9CB A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; Restart the cycle at offset 0
$05:C9CD 8D 43 14     STA.W $1443                     ; [$1443] = new phase offset
$05:C9D0 60           RTS                             ; Return
